# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Jan 31, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on expanding test coverage for the Supernode's interoperability features and enhancing the game arguments interface for chain operators.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Supernode Interoperability Testing
Extensive new acceptance tests were added to validate the Supernode's interoperability features, covering boundary conditions, cross-chain messaging, and timestamp progression. These tests aim to ensure robust and reliable Superchain interactions. ([#18970](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18970))

### Improved Dispute Game Configuration
The interface for defining dispute game configurations was improved, allowing chain operators to use clear arguments instead of raw bytes. This enhancement simplifies the setup and management of dispute games. ([#18952](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18952))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A pull request was opened to fix broken links, references, and typo errors within the codebase. ([#19040](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19040))
- Another pull request was opened to address a consensus issue by validating EIP-1559 parameters during decoding. ([#19039](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19039))

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were reported today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES
No active issues with more than 3 comments.
